lines.text: Every overpass is a bridge. But not every bridge is an overpass.
A bridge crosses water or a valley.
Trivia: the longest bridge, in China, is about 165 kilometers!
A tunnel goes through a hill, or under water.
An underpass is a short way under a road.
Trivia: the longest train tunnel runs 57 kilometers under the Alps.
My trick: over the road, overpass. Under the road, underpass.
